en.title: Stop Wrapping Every Endpoint in try/catch: Centralized Errors with ProblemDetails
en.subtitle: One exception handler at the top of the pipeline turns every failure into a standard RFC 9457 response, covers endpoints nobody wrapped, and keeps internals out of the body.
